concerns.text: T014a (Feature Extraction) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but explicitly 'Consumes output stream from T009'. T009 (Data Download) is a heavy I/O task that must complete before T014a can process the data. Marking T014a as [P] implies it can run concurrently with T009, violating the Producer-before-Consumer dependency. T014a must be [S] or explicitly dependent on T009 completion.

T018a (Validation) is marked [P] but depends on T017 (Feature Extraction) which is not marked as a prerequisite in the task list, and T017 depends on T014a-T016. The task description states 'Runs after T017', but the [P] tag suggests it can run in parallel with T014a-T017. This creates a race condition where validation runs before features are extracted.

T022 (Deviation Calculation) is marked [P] but its description states 'Input: Output of T021a and T023'. T021a and T023 are listed as separate tasks in the same phase. If T022 runs in parallel with T021a/T023, it will fail due to missing input data. T022 must be [S] and explicitly ordered after T021a and T023.

T033 (Sensitivity Analysis) is marked [US3] but the description requires it to 'Invoke the regeneration logic implemented in T013b/T013c'. T013b/T013c are in Phase 1 (Setup). While the dependency exists, T033 is marked [P] in the context of Phase 4, but it cannot run until T029a-T032 (Training/Significance) are implemented and T013b/T013c are executed. The [P] tag is misleading as it implies independence from the training tasks it consumes.

T009 is marked [P] but the description says 'Requires T004'. T004 (Contracts) is in Phase 1. While they are in the same phase, T009 cannot start until T004 files exist. The [P] tag should be removed or the dependency clarified to ensure T004 completes before T009 attempts to validate against the schema.
